delta: Vance went out to the core cradle alone and unslotted, with Quiej on the wire logging it. She read
  the yoke by hand, learned nothing from the seal ring that a thumb can learn, and found the read-key
  seating in under the lip, off the drawing. The slot in it was empty and she could not say what had been
  in it, or when. She told the wire to trust her and heard exactly how it sounded. She came up with the
  shape of the seating and no name for what is missing from it, and with the knowledge that the only hands
  that hold the name are her brother's.
